meta.title: Join the Explorers!
meta.textType: functional: an event poster for the first club meeting

paragraphs: On Monday, June first, Teacher Kim told the class about a new school club. "It is called the Explorers," she said. "Every member can go on a trip, write for a blog, and meet new friends." "The club has four groups, and each group has a project." "We do many fun activities together." "We meet in the school library every Thursday." The children had many questions. "What time is the first meeting?" asked May. "It is at one o'clock on Thursday," said Teacher Kim. "Can I bring my camera?" asked Mia. "Yes, a camera is a good idea," said Teacher Kim.

After lunch, Leo and Lily made a poster in the school library. "What shall we put on it?" asked Leo. "A poster for an event needs the date, the time, and the place," said Lily. Leo drew a compass and a boot with a thick marker. Lily wrote the words beside him with a pencil. "Children should come early, so they can find a seat," said Leo. Mia read every word of the poster and gave a big smile. Then she took a photo of it with her camera.

The poster was an invitation to every child in Primary Six. This is what it said. "JOIN THE EXPLORERS!" "First meeting: Thursday, June fourth." "Time: one o'clock." "Place: School Library." "Bring a pencil and a notebook." "Come early." "We go on a trip one Saturday each month." "Read our blog!" "See you soon!"

On Wednesday, Teacher Kim put a long list on the library door. The first name on the list was Mia's, and May wrote her name under it. Twenty-four children wrote their names on the list. "Do you want to join, too?" Lily asked a boy at the door. "Yes, I do," said the boy. "What time is the meeting?" "At one o'clock on Thursday," said Lily. "See you soon!" said the boy. "Now we have a real club!" said Leo with a big smile.
